name: @elizaos/testing

scripts.test: bun run test:fixtures && bun run scenarios:validate && bun run test:evidence && bun run test:runner && bun run test:synthetic-world && bun run test:runtime:e2e
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:fixtures && bun run typecheck:scenarios && bun run typecheck:evidence && bun run typecheck:runner && bun run typecheck:synthetic-world
scripts.format: bunx @biomejs/biome format --write package.json src scripts e2e scenarios evidence scenario-runner synthetic-world
scripts.format:check: bunx @biomejs/biome format package.json src scripts e2e scenarios evidence scenario-runner synthetic-world
scripts.lint: bunx @biomejs/biome check package.json src scripts e2e scenarios evidence scenario-runner synthetic-world
scripts.lint:check: bunx @biomejs/biome check package.json src scripts e2e scenarios evidence scenario-runner synthetic-world
scripts.lint:fix: bunx @biomejs/biome check --write package.json src scripts e2e scenarios evidence scenario-runner synthetic-world
scripts.test:deterministic:e2e: cd scenario-runner && SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run test/scenarios --lane pr-deterministic --report-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic --run-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic
scripts.test:corpus:pr:e2e: cd scenario-runner && TZ=UTC SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run ../scenarios --lane pr-deterministic --report-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic-corpus --run-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic-corpus
scripts.test:orchestrator:pr:e2e: cd scenario-runner && EVAL_MODEL_PROVIDER=deterministic SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 env -u CEREBRAS_API_KEY -u EVAL_CEREBRAS_API_KEY -u ELIZA_E2E_CEREBRAS_API_KEY bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run ../../../plugins/plugin-agent-orchestrator/test/scenarios --lane pr-deterministic --report-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic-orchestrator --run-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic-orchestrator --export-native ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic-orchestrator/native.jsonl
scripts.test:lifeops:pr:e2e: cd scenario-runner && TZ=UTC EVAL_MODEL_PROVIDER=deterministic SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 env -u CEREBRAS_API_KEY -u EVAL_CEREBRAS_API_KEY -u ELIZA_E2E_CEREBRAS_API_KEY bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run ../../../plugins/plugin-personal-assistant/test/scenarios --lane pr-deterministic --report-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic-lifeops --run-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic-lifeops --export-native ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/pr-deterministic-lifeops/native.jsonl
scripts.test:live:e2e: cd scenario-runner && bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run test/scenarios --lane live-only --report-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/live --run-dir ../../../test-results/scenario-runner/live
scripts.test:pr:e2e: bun run test:deterministic:e2e && bun run test:corpus:pr:e2e && bun run test:orchestrator:pr:e2e && bun run test:lifeops:pr:e2e && bun run test:notes:e2e
scripts.test:runtime:e2e: bun test --conditions=eliza-source e2e/perfect-result-runtime.e2e.test.ts e2e/fixture-lifecycle.e2e.test.ts e2e/synthetic-world-runtime.e2e.test.ts e2e/calendar-account-permissions.e2e.test.ts e2e/notes-calendar-runtime.e2e.test.ts e2e/scenario-seed-contract.e2e.test.ts

description: Runtime fixtures, scenario execution, synthetic-world control, and evidence tooling.
